s.d: πορισμός, -ου, ὁ (πορίζω, to procure), [in LXX: Wis.13:19 14:2 * ;] 1. a providing. 2. a means of gain: [[1-timothy 6 5|1Ti.6:5-6]] (Polyb., al.).† (AS)
Πόρκιος, -ου, ὁ Porcius, prænomen of Porcius Festus (see: Φῆστος): [[acts 24 27|Act.24:27.]]† (AS)

πορνεία, -ας, ἡ (πορνεύω), [in LXX for תַּזְנוּת and cogn. forms ;] fornication: [[acts 15 20|Act.15:20, 29 21:25]], [[1-corinthians 5 1|1Co.5:1 6:13 6:18]], [[2-corinthians 12 21|2Co.12:21]], [[galatians 5 19|Gal.5:19]], [[ephesians 5 3|Eph.5:3]], [[colossians 3 5|Col.3:5]], [[1-thessalonians 4 3|1Th.4:3]] (Lft., Notes, 53), [[revelation 9 21|Rev.9:21;]] pl. (see WM, 220; Bl., § 32, 6), [[1-corinthians 7 2|1Co.7:2;]] disting. from μοιχεία, [[matthew 15 19|Mat.15:19]], [[mark 7 21|Mrk.7:21]]; = μοιχεία ([[amos 8 17|Amos 8:17]] Sir.23:23, al.), [[matthew 5 32|Mat.5:32 19:9]]. Metaphorical (of idolatry: [[deuteronomy 23 2|Deu.23:2]], [[hosea 1 2|Hos.1:2]]): [[john 8 41|Jhn.8:41]] (Westc., in l), and so perh. (Thayer-Grimm, see word; but see Swete, in 11.), [[revelation 2 21|Rev.2:21 14:18 17:2, 4 18:3 19:2]].† (AS)

πορνεύω [in LXX for זָנָה ;] 1. to prostitute the body for hire. 2. to commit fornication: [[mark 10 19|Mrk.10:19]] (WH, mg), [[1-corinthians 6 18|1Co.6:18 10:8]], [[revelation 2 14|Rev.2:14, 20]]. Metaphorical (as in LXX: [[1-chronicles 5 25|1Ch.5:25]], [[jeremiah 3 6|Jer.3:6]], [[hosea 9 1|Hos.9:1]], al.), of idolatry (but see Swete, Ap., 180 f.), [[revelation 17 2|Rev.17:2 18:3, 9]] (cf. ἐκ- πορνεύω).† (AS)

πόρνη, -ης, ἡ [in LXX chiefly for זָנָה ;] a prostitute, harlot: [[matthew 21 31|Mat.21:31-32]], [[luke 15 30|Luk.15:30]], [[1-corinthians 6 15|1Co.6:15-16]] [[hebrews 11 31|Heb.11:31]], [[james 2 25|Jas.2:25]]. Metaphorical (see Swete, Ap., 180 f.), of Babylon (i.e. Rome): [[revelation 17 1|Rev.17:1, 5 17:15-16 19:2]].† (AS)

πόρνος, -ου, ὁ [in LXX: Sir.23:16-18 * ;] 1. a male prostitute (Xen., al.). 2. a fornicator: [[1-corinthians 5 9|1Co.5:9-11 6:9]], [[ephesians 5 5|Eph.5:5]], [[1-timothy 1 10|1Ti.1:10]], [[hebrews 12 15|Heb.12:15 13:4]], [[revelation 21 8|Rev.21:8 22:15]].† (AS)

πόρρω adv. (in older Attic, πρόσω), [in LXX for רָחוֹק, etc. ;] far off: [[matthew 15 8|Mat.15:8]], [[mark 7 6|Mrk.7:6]]" (LXX), [[luke 14 32|Luk.14:32;]] comparat., πορρώτερον (-ρω, T), [[luke 24 28|Luk.24:28.]]† (AS)
πόρρωθεν adv. (τόρρω, which see), [in LXX for רָחוֹק and cogn. forms ;] from afar: [[luke 17 12|Luk.17:12]], [[hebrews 11 13|Heb.11:13]].† (AS)

farther
farther, onwards, beyond

πορφύρα, -ας, ἡ [in LXX for אַרְגָּמָן, אַרְגְּוָן ;] 1. the purple fish (cf. 1Ma.4:23). 2. purple dye. 3. Later, = πορφυρίς, a purple gar­ment: [[mark 15 17|Mrk.15:17, 20]], [[luke 16 19|Luk.16:19]], [[revelation 18 12|Rev.18:12]].† (AS)
πορφύρεος, -α, -ον contr., -οῦς, -ᾶ, -οῦν (ποπφύρα), [in LXX for אַרְגָּמָן ;] purple: [[john 19 2|Jhn.19:2]], 5; as subst., πορφυροῦν (sc. ἱμάτιον), [[revelation 17 4|Rev.17:4 18:6]].† (AS)
πορφυρόπωλις, -ιδος, ἡ a seller of purple fabrics: [[acts 16 14|Act.16:14.]]† (AS)
ποσάκις interrog. num. adv., how often: [[matthew 18 21|Mat.18:21 23:37]], [[luke 13 34|Luk.13:34]].† (AS)

πόσις, -εως, ἡ (πίνω), [in LXX: Da, LXX TH [[daniel 1 10|Dan.1:10]] (מִשְׁתֶּה) * ;] 1. prop., drinking: [[romans 14 17|Rom.14:17]], [[colossians 2 16|Col.2:16]] (see Lft.; ICC, in l). 2. = πόμα, drink: [[john 6 55|Jhn.6:55]] (cf. βρῶσις).† (AS)

πόσος, -η, -ον adj. of number, magnitude, degree, etc., how much, how great, how many: [[matthew 6 23|Mat.6:23]], [[2-corinthians 7 11|2Co.7:11]]; of time, [[mark 9 21|Mrk.9:21;]] neut., absol., [[luke 16 5|Luk.16:5]], 7; dative, πόσῳ, adverbially, how much, [[matthew 12 12|Mat.12:12;]] id. before μᾶλλον, [[matthew 7 11|Mat.7:11 10:25]], [[luke 11 13|Luk.11:13 12:24, 28]], [[romans 11 12|Rom.11:12, 24]], Phm 16, [[hebrews 9 14|Heb.9:14]]; π. χείρονος τιμωρίας, [[hebrews 10 29|Heb.10:29;]] pl., [[matthew 15 34|Mat.15:34 16:9-10 27:13]], [[mark 6 38|Mrk.6:38 8:5, 19-20 15:4]], [[luke 15 17|Luk.15:17]], [[acts 21 20|Act.21:20]].† (AS)

ποταμός, -οῦ, ὁ [in LXX chiefly for נָהָר, יְאֹר ;] a river, stream, torrent: [[matthew 3 5|Mat.3:5 7:25, 27]], [[mark 1 1|Mrk.1:1-45]] :, [[luke 6 48|Luk.6:48-49]], [[acts 16 13|Act.16:13]], [[2-corinthians 11 26|2Co.11:26]], [[revelation 8 10|Rev.8:10 9:14 12:15-16 16:4, 12 21:1-2]]. Fig., pl., π. ὕδατος ζῶντος, [[john 7 38|Jhn.7:38.]]† (AS)
ποταμο-φόρητος, -ον carried away by a stream: [[revelation 12 15|Rev.12:15]] (for two exx. in π., see MM, xxi).† (AS)

ποταπός (late form of cl. ποδ-), -ή, -όν, [in LXX: Dan LXX Su 1:54* ;] 1. (= ποδαπός) from what country? 2. In late writers, = ποῖος, of what sort?: [[matthew 8 27|Mat.8:27]], [[mark 13 1|Mrk.13:1]], [[luke 1 29|Luk.1:29 7:39]], [[2-peter 3 11|2Pe.3:11]], [[1-john 3 1|1Jn.3:1]].† (AS)

ποτέ enclitic particle, 1. once, formerly, sometime: of the past, [[john 9 13|Jhn.9:13]] [[romans 7 9|Rom.7:9 11:30]], [[galatians 1 13|Gal.1:13, 23 2:6]] (Lft., in l), [[ephesians 2 2|Eph.2:2-3, 11 2:13 5:8]], [[colossians 1 21|Col.1:21 3:7]], [[1-thessalonians 2 5|1Th.2:5]], [[titus 3 3|Tit.3:3]], Phm 11, [[1-peter 2 10|1Pe.2:10 3:5 3:20]]; ἤδη ποτέ, now at length, [[philippians 4 10|Php.4:10;]] of the fut., [[luke 22 32|Luk.22:32;]] εἴ πως ἤδη ποτέ, if sometime soon at length, [[romans 1 10|Rom.1:10.]] 2. ever: after a neg., [[ephesians 5 29|Eph.5:29]], [[2-peter 1 10|2Pe.1:10 1:21]]; in a question, τίς π., [[1-corinthians 9 7|1Co.9:7]], [[hebrews 1 5|Heb.1:5, 13]].† (AS)

πότε interrog. adv. of time, when?: [[matthew 25 37|Mat.25:37-39, 44]] [[luke 21 7|Luk.21:7]], [[john 6 25|Jhn.6:25]]; ἕως π., how long: [[matthew 17 17|Mat.17:17]], [[mark 9 19|Mrk.9:19]], [[luke 9 41|Luk.9:41]], [[john 10 24|Jhn.10:24]], [[revelation 6 10|Rev.6:10]]. In indir. questions, = ὁπότε, [[matthew 24 3|Mat.24:3]], [[mark 13 4|Mrk.13:4, 33 13:35]], [[luke 12 36|Luk.12:36 17:20]] (see Bl., § 25, 4).† (AS)
πότερος, -α, -ον which of two. Neut., adverbially, πότερον, whether: [[john 7 17|Jhn.7:17.]]† (AS)

ποτήριον, -ου, τό dimin. of ποτήρ (πίνω), [in LXX chiefly for כּוֹס:] a wine cup: [[matthew 23 25|Mat.23:25-26 26:27]], [[mark 7 4|Mrk.7:4 14:23]], [[luke 11 39|Luk.11:39 22:17, 20]] a (WH, R, mg., cm.), [[1-corinthians 11 25|1Co.11:25]], [[revelation 17 4|Rev.17:4]]; πίνειν ἐκ τοῦ π., [[1-corinthians 11 28|1Co.11:28;]] with genitive of thing(s), [[matthew 10 42|Mat.10:42]], [[mark 9 41|Mrk.9:41]]; τ. εὐλογίας, [[1-corinthians 10 16|1Co.10:16;]] by meton., of the contents of the cup, [[luke 22 20|Luk.22:20]] b (WH, R, mg., cm.), [[1-corinthians 11 25|1Co.11:25-26;]] with genitive of person(s), [[1-corinthians 10 21|1Co.10:21 11:27]]. Metaphorical, of experience of divine providence; of prosperity ([[psalms 16 5|Psa.16:5]], al.); of adversity ([[psalms 11 6|Psa.11:6]], [[isaiah 51 17|Isa.51:17]], al.): of the sufferings of Christ, [[matthew 20 22|Mat.20:22-23 26:39 10:38-39 14:36]], [[luke 22 42|Luk.22:42]], [[john 18 11|Jhn.18:11]]; of divine punishment, [[revelation 14 10|Rev.14:10 16:19 18:6]].† (AS)

ποτίζω (πότος), [in LXX chiefly for שָׁקָה hi. ;] to give to drink: with accusative of person(s), [[matthew 25 35|Mat.25:35, 37 25:42 27:48]], [[mark 15 36|Mrk.15:36]], [[luke 13 15|Luk.13:15]], [[romans 12 20|Rom.12:20]]; with dupl. accusative, [[matthew 10 42|Mat.10:42]], [[mark 9 41|Mrk.9:41]]; fig., γάλα, [[1-corinthians 3 2|1Co.3:2;]] ἐκ τ. οἴνου [[revelation 14 8|Rev.14:8;]] of plants, to water (Xen., Strab., al.; [[genesis 13 10|Gen.13:10]]), figuratively, [[1-corinthians 3 6|1Co.3:6-8]] Metaphorical (cf. [[isaiah 29 10|Isa.29:10]] Sir.15:3), of the Spirit, [[1-corinthians 12 13|1Co.12:13.]]† (AS)
Ποτίολοι, -ων, οἱ Puteoli (mod. Pozzuoli), a city on the Bay of Naples: [[acts 28 13|Act.28:13.]]† (AS)
πότος, -ου, ὁ (πίνω), [in LXX chiefly for מִשְׁתֶּה ;] a drinking bout, carousal: [[1-peter 4 3|1Pe.4:3.]]† SYN.: see: κραιπάλη (AS)

πού enclitic particle, 1. anywhere, somewhere: [[hebrews 2 6|Heb.2:6 4:4]]. 2. in some degree, perhaps, about: [[acts 27 29|Act.27:29]] (T, μήπου), [[romans 4 19|Rom.4:19;]] δή που (T, δήπου), surely: [[hebrews 2 16|Heb.2:16.]]† (AS)

ποῦ interrog. adv., [in LXX for אַי, אַיֵּה, אָן ;] 1. prop., where?: [[matthew 2 2|Mat.2:2 26:17]], [[mark 14 12|Mrk.14:12, 14]], [[luke 17 17|Luk.17:17, 37 22:9, 11]], [[john 1 39|Jhn.1:39 7:11 8:10, 19 9:12 11:34]]; ποῦ (ἐστιν), indicating that the subject in question is not to be found, [[luke 8 25|Luk.8:25]], [[romans 3 27|Rom.3:27]], [[1-corinthians 1 20|1Co.1:20 12:17 12:19 15:55]], [[galatians 4 15|Gal.4:15]], [[2-peter 3 4|2Pe.3:4]]; ποῦ φανεῖται, [[1-peter 4 18|1Pe.4:18.]] 2. = ὅπου (WM, 640; B1., § 50, 5): with indic., [[matthew 2 4|Mat.2:4]], [[mark 15 47|Mrk.15:47]], [[john 1 40|Jhn.1:40 11:57 20:2, 13 20:15]] [[revelation 2 13|Rev.2:13]]; with subjc., [[matthew 8 20|Mat.8:20]], [[luke 9 58|Luk.9:58 12:17]]. 3. In colloq. (as in Eng.) = ποῖ, whither: in direct questions, [[john 7 35|Jhn.7:35 9:12 13:36 16:5]]; in indir. quest., [[john 3 8|Jhn.3:8 8:14 12:35 14:5]], [[hebrews 11 8|Heb.11:8]], [[1-john 2 11|1Jn.2:11]].† (AS)
Πούδης (in π., genitive -εντος, see Zorell, see word), ὁ (Latin) Pudens: [[2-timothy 4 21|2Ti.4:21.]]† (AS)

πούς, ποδός, ὁ [in LXX chiefly for רֶגֶל ;] a foot, both of men and beasts: [[matthew 4 6|Mat.4:6]] (LXX), [[mark 9 45|Mrk.9:45]], [[luke 1 79|Luk.1:79]], [[john 11 44|Jhn.11:44]], [[acts 7 5|Act.7:5]], al.; ὑπο τοὺς π., [[romans 16 20|Rom.16:20]], [[1-corinthians 15 25|1Co.15:25 15:27]] [[ephesians 1 22|Eph.1:22]], [[hebrews 2 8|Heb.2:8]]; ὑποκάτω τῶν π., [[matthew 22 44|Mat.22:44]] (LXX); πρὸς (παρὰ) τοὺς π., [[mark 5 22|Mrk.5:22]], [[luke 8 41|Luk.8:41]], al.; figuratively, [[matthew 15 30|Mat.15:30]], [[luke 10 39|Luk.10:39]], [[acts 5 2|Act.5:2]], al.; ἔμπροσθεν τῶν π., [[revelation 3 9|Rev.3:9 19:10]], al.; ἐπὶ τοὺς π., [[acts 10 25|Act.10:25.]] By meton., of a person in motion ([[psalms 119 101|Psa.119:101]]): [[luke 1 79|Luk.1:79]], [[acts 5 9|Act.5:9]], [[romans 3 15|Rom.3:15 10:15]], [[hebrews 12 13|Heb.12:13]] (AS)

πρᾶγμα, -τος, τύ (πράσσω), [in LXX chiefly for דָּבָר ;] 1. that which has been done, a deed, act: [[luke 1 1|Luk.1:1]], [[acts 5 4|Act.5:4]], [[2-corinthians 7 11|2Co.7:11]], [[hebrews 6 18|Heb.6:18]]. 2. That which is being done (like Lat. res), hence, a thing, matter, affair: [[matthew 18 19|Mat.18:19]], [[romans 16 2|Rom.16:2]], [[1-thessalonians 4 6|1Th.4:6]] (see M, Th., in l), [[hebrews 10 1|Heb.10:1 11:1]], [[james 3 16|Jas.3:16]]; in forensic sense (as frequently in π., see Deiss., BS, 233), a law-suit: [[1-corinthians 6 1|1Co.6:1.]]† (AS)
πραγματία (Rec. -εία, as in cl.), -ας, ἡ (πραγματεύομαι) [in LXX for חֲשַׁל, etc. ;] 1. careful application, hard work. 2. business, occupation: pl., [[2-timothy 2 4|2Ti.2:4.]]† (AS)

πραγματεύομαι (πρᾶγμα), [in LXX: [[1-kings 10 22|3Ki.10:22]] B, [[1-kings 9 19|3Ki.9:19]] A (חָשַׁק), Dan LXX 8:27 (מְלָאכָה ־אֵת עָשָׂה) * ;] 1. to busy oneself. 2. to be engaged in business, esp. to trade: [[luke 19 13|Luk.19:13]] (cf. δια-πραγματεύομαι).† (AS)

πραιτώριον, -ου, τό (Lat. prætorium) 1. headquarters in a Roman camp, 2. The palace or official residence of the Governor of a province: [[matthew 27 27|Mat.27:27]], [[mark 15 16|Mrk.15:16]] (see Swete, in l), [[john 18 28|Jhn.18:28, 33 19:9]]; τ. π. τ. Ἡρώδου, [[acts 23 35|Act.23:35.]] 3. the Prætorian Guard: [[philippians 1 13|Php.1:13]] (see Lft., in l; ICC, 51 f.).† (AS)

πράκτωρ, -ορος, ὁ (πράσσω), [in LXX: [[isaiah 3 12|Isa.3:12]] (נָגַשׁ) * ;] 1. (poët.) one who does or accomplishes. 2. In Athens, one who exacts payment, a collector; hence, generally (frequently in π., see Deiss., BS, 154), a court officer: [[luke 12 58|Luk.12:58.]]† (AS)

πρᾶξις, -εως, ἡ (πράσσω), [in LXX: [[2-chronicles 13 22|2Ch.13:22 27:7 28:26]] (דֶּרֶךְ), [[job 24 5|Job.24:5]] A (פֹּעַל), [[proverbs 13 13|Pro.13:13]], Wis.9:11, al. ;] 1. a doing, deed, act: [[matthew 16 27|Mat.16:27;]] pl., π. ἀποσπτόλων, Ac, title; in late writers especially of wicked deeds or practices (frequently in Polyb.): [[luke 23 51|Luk.23:51;]] p1., [[romans 8 13|Rom.8:13]], [[colossians 3 9|Col.3:9]]; with ref. to magic (see BS, 3235), [[acts 19 18|Act.19:18.]] 2. an acting, action, business, function: [[romans 12 4|Rom.12:4.]]† (AS)

πρᾷος, πρᾶος, see: πραΰς. πραΰς, -εῖα, -ΰ, and πρᾷος (Or πρᾶος, ν. Bl., § 3, 3), -α, -ον (see LS, Thayer, see word), [in LXX (always -ΰς, exc. 2Ma.15:12, -ᾷος, see Thackeray, Gr., 180 f.) for עָנָו, עָנִי ;] gentle, meek: [[matthew 5 5|Mat.5:5 11:29 21:5]]" (LXX) [[1-peter 3 4|1Pe.3:4.]]† (AS)

πρᾳότης, πραότης, see: πραΰτης. πραΰτης (Rec. -ότης, exc. Ja, 1Pe, ll. with, where πρᾳύτης), -ητος, ἡ, late form of πραότης, [in LXX: [[psalms 45 4|Psa.45:4 90:10 132:1]] (עַנְוָה, עֱנוּת, [[esther 5 1|Est.5:1]], Sir.6:1-37 * ;] gentleness, meekness: [[1-corinthians 4 21|1Co.4:21]], [[2-corinthians 10 1|2Co.10:1]], [[galatians 5 23|Gal.5:23 6:1]], [[ephesians 4 2|Eph.4:2]], [[colossians 3 12|Col.3:12]] (see Lft., in l), 2Ti_2:25, [[titus 3 2|Tit.3:2]], [[james 1 21|Jas.1:21 3:13]], [[1-peter 3 15|1Pe.3:15]].† SIN.: ἐπιεικία, q.v (AS)
πρασιά, -ᾶς, ἡ [in LXX: Sir.24:31 * ;] a garden-bed; metaphorically, of ranks or orderly groups of persons: [[mark 6 40|Mrk.6:40.]]† (AS)

πράσσω (Att.. -ττω, and so [[acts 17 7|Act.17:7]] Rec.; cf. M, Pr., 25, 45), [in LXX chiefly for עָשָׂה, פָּעַל ;] = Lat agere, as ποιέω (which see) = facere, 1. to do, practise, be engaged in: [[acts 19 19|Act.19:19, 36]], [[1-corinthians 9 17|1Co.9:17]]; τ. ἴδια π., to mind one's own business (τὰ ἑαυτοῦ, Soph., Plat.), [[1-thessalonians 4 11|1Th.4:11;]] intrans., to act, [[acts 17 7|Act.17:7.]] 2. to achieve, effect, accomplish, perform: [[acts 26 20|Act.26:20, 26]] [[romans 7 15|Rom.7:15 9:11]], [[2-corinthians 5 10|2Co.5:10]], [[philippians 4 9|Php.4:9]]; νόμον (ICC, in l), [[romans 2 25|Rom.2:25;]] of unworthy acts (for WH. usually ποιέω in cl.), to commit, do: [[luke 22 23|Luk.22:23 23:41]], [[john 3 20|Jhn.3:20 5:29]], [[acts 3 17|Act.3:17 5:35 16:28 25:11, 25 26:9, 31]], [[romans 1 32|Rom.1:32]] (ICC, in l), [[romans 2 1|Rom.2:1-3 7:19 13:4]], [[1-corinthians 5 2|1Co.5:2]], [[2-corinthians 12 21|2Co.12:21]], [[galatians 5 21|Gal.5:21]]. 3. to transact, manage, hence, of payment, to exact (cl.): [[luke 3 13|Luk.3:13 19:23]]. 4. Reflexively, of state or condition, to do or fare Æsch., Hdt., al.): [[ephesians 6 21|Eph.6:21;]] εὖ π. (see M, Pr., 228 f.), [[acts 15 29|Act.15:29.]]† SYN.: see: ποιέω (AS)

πραΰς, -εῖα, -ΰ, and πρᾷος (Or πρᾶος, ν. Bl., § 3, 3), -α, -ον (see LS, Thayer, see word), [in LXX (always -ΰς, exc. 2Ma.15:12, -ᾷος, see Thackeray, Gr., 180 f.) for עָנָו, עָנִי ;] gentle, meek: [[matthew 5 5|Mat.5:5 11:29 21:5]]" (LXX) [[1-peter 3 4|1Pe.3:4.]]† (AS)

πραΰτης (Rec. -ότης, exc. Ja, 1Pe, ll. with, where πρᾳύτης), -ητος, ἡ, late form of πραότης, [in LXX: [[psalms 45 4|Psa.45:4 90:10 132:1]] (עַנְוָה, עֱנוּת, [[esther 5 1|Est.5:1]], Sir.6:1-37 * ;] gentleness, meekness: [[1-corinthians 4 21|1Co.4:21]], [[2-corinthians 10 1|2Co.10:1]], [[galatians 5 23|Gal.5:23 6:1]], [[ephesians 4 2|Eph.4:2]], [[colossians 3 12|Col.3:12]] (see Lft., in l), 2Ti_2:25, [[titus 3 2|Tit.3:2]], [[james 1 21|Jas.1:21 3:13]], [[1-peter 3 15|1Pe.3:15]].† SIN.: ἐπιεικία, q.v (AS)

πρέπω [in LXX: [[psalms 93 5|Psa.93:5]] (נָאָה pi.), etc. ;] 1. to be clearly seen. 2. to resemble. 3. to be fitting or becoming, to suit: with dative, [[hebrews 7 26|Heb.7:26]], [[1-timothy 2 10|1Ti.2:10]], [[titus 2 1|Tit.2:1]]; impers., with dative, [[ephesians 5 3|Eph.5:3;]] id. before inf., [[hebrews 2 10|Heb.2:10;]] πρέπον ἐστίν, with dative of person(s) and inf., [[matthew 3 15|Mat.3:15;]] with accusative and inf., [[1-corinthians 11 13|1Co.11:13]] (see Bl., § 72, 5).† (AS)
πρεσβεία, -ας, ἡ (πρεσβεύω), [in LXX: 2Ma.4:11 * ;] 1. age, seniority. 2. rank, dignity. 3. an embassy; by meton., of the am­bassadors, embassy: [[luke 14 32|Luk.14:32 19:14]].† (AS)
πρεσβεύω (πρέσβυς), 1. to be the elder, to take precedence. 2. to be an ambassador (see: πρεσβύτης): [[2-corinthians 5 20|2Co.5:20]], [[ephesians 6 20|Eph.6:20]].† (AS)

πρεσβυτέριον, -ου, τό (πρεσβύτερος) [in LXX: Da TH Su 1:50 A * ;] a body of elders, presbytery: of the Sanhedrin (cf. συνέδριον), [[luke 22 66|Luk.22:66]], [[acts 22 5|Act.22:5]]; of Christian presbyters, [[1-timothy 4 14|1Ti.4:14.]]† (AS)

πρέσβυς, -εως, ὁ poët. form of πρεσβύτης (which see), [in LXX (= πρεσβευτής, an ambassador): [[numbers 21 20|Num.21:20]] (21), al. (מֲלְאָךְ), [[isaiah 13 8|Isa.13:8 57:9]] (צִיר), 1Ma.9:70, al. ;] an old man. Compar., πρεσβύτερος, -α, -ον, [in LXX chiefly for זָקֵן ;] 1. of age, elder: ὁ νἱὸς ὁ π., [[luke 15 25|Luk.15:25;]] as subst., opposite to νεανίσκοι, [[acts 2 17|Act.2:17;]] to νεώτερος, [[1-timothy 5 1|1Ti.5:1-2;]] of the religious leaders of the past, [[matthew 15 2|Mat.15:2]], [[mark 7 3|Mrk.7:3]], 5, [[hebrews 11 2|Heb.11:2]] (= οἱ πατέρες, [[hebrews 1 1|Heb.1:1]]). 2. Of dignity, rank or office (as found in π. and Inscr. of civil and religious offices, including priesthood, in Asia Minor and in Egypt; see Deiss., BS, 154 ff., 233 If.; LAE, 373); (a) among Jews: [[matthew 16 21|Mat.16:21 26:47, 57 27:3, 12 27:20, 41 28:12]], [[mark 8 31|Mrk.8:31 11:27 14:43, 53 15:1]], [[luke 7 3|Luk.7:3 9:22 20:1 22:52]], [[john 8 9|Jhn.8:9]], [[acts 4 5|Act.4:5, 8 4:23 6:12 23:14 24:1]]; τ. Ἰουνδαίων, [[acts 25 15|Act.25:15;]] τ. λαοῦ, [[matthew 21 23|Mat.21:23 26:3 27:1]]; (b) among Christians: [[acts 11 30|Act.11:30 14:23 15:2, 4 15:6, 22-23 16:4 21:18]], [[1-timothy 5 17|1Ti.5:17 5:19]], [[titus 1 5|Tit.1:5]], II Jn 1, 3Jn.1, [[1-peter 5 1|1Pe.5:1 5:5]]; τ. ἐκκλησίας, [[acts 20 17|Act.20:17]], [[james 5 14|Jas.5:14]]; (with) in the visions of the Apocalypse: [[revelation 4 4|Rev.4:4, 10 5:5-6, 8 5:11, 14 7:11, 13 11:16 14:3 19:4]]. (On the NT use of this word and its relation to ἐπίσκοπος (which see), cf. Lft., Phi., 93 ff., 189 ff.; CGT, Past. Epp., lvi ff.) † (AS)

πρέσβυς, -εως, ὁ poët. form of πρεσβύτης (which see), [in LXX (= πρεσβευτής, an ambassador): [[numbers 21 20|Num.21:20]] (21), al. (מֲלְאָךְ), [[isaiah 13 8|Isa.13:8 57:9]] (צִיר), 1Ma.9:70, al. ;] an old man. Compar., πρεσβύτερος, -α, -ον, [in LXX chiefly for זָקֵן ;] 1. of age, elder: ὁ νἱὸς ὁ π., [[luke 15 25|Luk.15:25;]] as subst., opposite to νεανίσκοι, [[acts 2 17|Act.2:17;]] to νεώτερος, [[1-timothy 5 1|1Ti.5:1-2;]] of the religious leaders of the past, [[matthew 15 2|Mat.15:2]], [[mark 7 3|Mrk.7:3]], 5, [[hebrews 11 2|Heb.11:2]] (= οἱ πατέρες, [[hebrews 1 1|Heb.1:1]]). 2. Of dignity, rank or office (as found in π. and Inscr. of civil and religious offices, including priesthood, in Asia Minor and in Egypt; see Deiss., BS, 154 ff., 233 If.; LAE, 373); (a) among Jews: [[matthew 16 21|Mat.16:21 26:47, 57 27:3, 12 27:20, 41 28:12]], [[mark 8 31|Mrk.8:31 11:27 14:43, 53 15:1]], [[luke 7 3|Luk.7:3 9:22 20:1 22:52]], [[john 8 9|Jhn.8:9]], [[acts 4 5|Act.4:5, 8 4:23 6:12 23:14 24:1]]; τ. Ἰουνδαίων, [[acts 25 15|Act.25:15;]] τ. λαοῦ, [[matthew 21 23|Mat.21:23 26:3 27:1]]; (b) among Christians: [[acts 11 30|Act.11:30 14:23 15:2, 4 15:6, 22-23 16:4 21:18]], [[1-timothy 5 17|1Ti.5:17 5:19]], [[titus 1 5|Tit.1:5]], II Jn 1, 3Jn.1, [[1-peter 5 1|1Pe.5:1 5:5]]; τ. ἐκκλησίας, [[acts 20 17|Act.20:17]], [[james 5 14|Jas.5:14]]; (with) in the visions of the Apocalypse: [[revelation 4 4|Rev.4:4, 10 5:5-6, 8 5:11, 14 7:11, 13 11:16 14:3 19:4]]. (On the NT use of this word and its relation to ἐπίσκοπος (which see), cf. Lft., Phi., 93 ff., 189 ff.; CGT, Past. Epp., lvi ff.) † (AS)

πρεσβύτης, -ου prose form of πρέσβυς, which see, [in LXX chiefly for זָקֵן, [[genesis 25 8|Gen.25:8]], al.; also (= πρεσβευτής), [[2-chronicles 32 31|2Ch.32:31]] Bl (לוּץ), 1Ma.14:22 S, al. (see Thackeray, Gr., 97) ;] 1. an old man: [[luke 1 18|Luk.1:18]], [[titus 2 2|Tit.2:2]], Phm 9 (R, txt., but see infr.). 2. As in LXX, also = πρεσβευτής, an am­bassador: Phm 9 (R, mg., see Lft. and ICC, in l).† (AS)
πρεσβῦτις, -ιδος, ἡ fem, of πρεσβύτης, [in LXX: 4Ma.16:14 * ;] an aged woman: [[titus 2 3|Tit.2:3.]]† (AS)
πρηνής, -ές (in Att.. also πρανής), [in LXX: Wis.4:19, 3Ma.5:43 3Mac 5:50 3Mac 6:23 * ;] headlong, prone: [[acts 1 18|Act.1:18.]]† (AS)
πρίζω = πρίω, [in LXX: [[amos 1 3|Amo.1:3]], Da TH Su 1:59 * ;] to saw, saw asunder (= π. δίχα, Thuc., iv, 100): pass, [[hebrews 11 37|Heb.11:37]] (cf. δια-πρίω).† (AS)

πρίν 1. as adv. of time, before, formerly (cl.; 3Ma.5:28 3Mac 6:4 3Mac 6:31) 2. As conic. (cl.), before; (a) after a positive sentence, with accusative and inf.: [[matthew 26 34|Mat.26:34, 75]], [[mark 14 72|Mrk.14:72]], [[luke 22 61|Luk.22:61]], [[john 4 49|Jhn.4:49 8:58]] (where D. om. γενέσθαι and π. becomes prep. with genitive; see Bl., § 69, 7) [[john 14 29|Jhn.14:29]], [[acts 2 20|Act.2:20]]" (LXX), WH, txt.; πρὶν ἤ (not such good Attic in this construction; see Bl., l.with), [[matthew 1 18|Mat.1:18]] [[mark 14 30|Mrk.14:30]], [[acts 2 20|Act.2:20]], WH, mg., [[acts 7 2|Act.7:2;]] (b) after a negative sentence, πρὶν ἤ: a. subjc. (before ἄν, M, Pr., 169), [[luke 2 26|Luk.2:26;]] with optative, [[acts 25 16|Act.25:16.]]† (AS)
Πρίσκα, -ας, ἡ (Lat.), and Πρίσκιλλα, -ης, ἡ, Prisca: Rom_16:3, 1Co_16:19, 2Ti_4:19; Priscilla: Act_18:2; Act_18:18; Act_18:26; the wife of Aquila, vs. Ἀκύλας.† (AS)
Πρίσκιλλα, see: Πρίσκα. Πρίσκα, -ας, ἡ (Lat.), and Πρίσκιλλα, -ης, ἡ, Prisca: Rom_16:3, 1Co_16:19, 2Ti_4:19; Priscilla: Act_18:2; Act_18:18; Act_18:26; the wife of Aquila, vs. Ἀκύλας.† (AS)

πρό prep. with genitive, [in LXX chiefly for פָּנִים ;] before; (a) of place: [[acts 12 6|Act.12:6, 14 14:13]], [[james 5 9|Jas.5:9]]; π. προσώπου (= Heb. פָּנִים, [[deuteronomy 3 18|Deu.3:18]], [[malachi 3 1|Mal.3:1]], al.; Bl., § 40, 9), [[matthew 11 10|Mat.11:10]], [[mark 1 2|Mrk.1:2]], [[luke 1 76|Luk.1:76 7:27 9:52 10:1]], [[acts 14 13|Act.14:13]]; (b) of time: [[matthew 8 29|Mat.8:29 24:38]], [[luke 11 38|Luk.11:38 21:12]], [[john 11 55|Jhn.11:55 13:1 17:24]], [[acts 5 36|Act.5:36 21:38]], [[1-corinthians 2 7|1Co.2:7 4:5]], [[ephesians 1 4|Eph.1:4]], [[colossians 1 17|Col.1:17]], [[2-timothy 1 9|2Ti.1:9 4:21]], [[titus 1 2|Tit.1:2]], [[hebrews 11 5|Heb.11:5]], [[1-peter 1 20|1Pe.1:20]], Ju 25; π. ἐτῶν δεκατεσσάρων, fourteen years ago, [[2-corinthians 12 2|2Co.12:2;]] π. προσώπου (see supr.), [[acts 13 24|Act.13:24;]] with genitive of person(s), [[matthew 5 12|Mat.5:12]], [[john 5 7|Jhn.5:7 10:8]], [[romans 16 7|Rom.16:7]], [[galatians 1 17|Gal.1:17]]; with genitive art. inf. (= πρίν; M, Pr., 100; Bl., § 69, 7), [[matthew 6 8|Mat.6:8]] [[luke 2 21|Luk.2:21 22:15]], [[john 1 49|Jhn.1:49 13:19 17:5]], [[acts 23 15|Act.23:15]], [[galatians 2 12|Gal.2:12 3:23]]; as in late writers (resembling a Latin idiom but indepen­dent of it; B1., § 40, 5; M, Pr., 100 f.; of. Am 2Ma.15:36, and for other exx., Soph., Lex., see word), πρὸ ἓξ ἡμέρας τοῦ πάσχα, on the sixth day before the Passover, [[john 12 1|Jhn.12:1;]] (with) of preference: π. πάντων, [[james 5 12|Jas.5:12]], [[1-peter 4 8|1Pe.4:8]]; (d) in compos., α with subst., of position before: προαύλιον, πρόδρομος; priority of rank or order, προπάτωρ; anticipation, πρό γνωσις, πρό νοια; β with adj., intensity, πρόδηλος; γ with verb., of place, προάγω, προβαίνω; of preference, προαιρέομαι.† (AS)

προ-άγω [in LXX: [[1-samuel 17 16|1Ki.17:16]] (נָגַשׁ), Wis.19:11, al. ;] 1. prop. trans., to lead on, lead forth or forward: with accusative of person(s), [[acts 16 30|Act.16:30 17:5]]; of bringing forth to trial, [[acts 12 6|Act.12:6]] (WH, txt., προσάγ-); before ἐπί, with genitive of person(s), [[acts 25 26|Act.25:26.]] 2. Intrans. (Plat., Polyb., and later writers; see Bl., § 53, 1; MM, xxi); (a) to lead the way, [[1-timothy 1 18|1Ti.1:18]] (R, mg.), hence, to go before, precede: [[luke 18 39|Luk.18:39;]] opposite to ἀκολουθέω, [[mark 11 9|Mrk.11:9;]] before εἰς, [[matthew 14 22|Mat.14:22]], [[mark 6 45|Mrk.6:45]], [[1-timothy 5 24|1Ti.5:24]], [[hebrews 7 18|Heb.7:18]]; with accusative of person(s), [[matthew 2 9|Mat.2:9 21:9]], [[mark 10 32|Mrk.10:32]]; before εἰς, [[matthew 21 31|Mat.21:31 26:32 28:7]], [[mark 14 28|Mrk.14:28 16:7]]; (b) to go on, advance (Sir.20:27): 2Jn.9.† (AS)
προ-αιρέω, -ῶ [in LXX: for חָשַׁק, etc. ;] to bring forth or forward. Most frequently in mid., to take by choice, prefer, propose: [[2-corinthians 9 7|2Co.9:7.]]† (AS)
προ-αιτιάομαι, -ῶμαι to accuse or charge beforehand: [[romans 3 9|Rom.3:9]] (not elsewhere) .† (AS)
προ-ακούω to hear beforehand: [[colossians 1 5|Col.1:5]] (see Lft., in l).† (AS)
προ-αμαρτάνω to sin before: [[2-corinthians 12 21|2Co.12:21 13:2]].† (AS)
προ-αύλιον, -ου, τό (πρό, αὐλή), a porch, vestibule: [[mark 14 68|Mrk.14:68.]]† (AS)

προ-βαίνω [in LXX chiefly for בּוֹא ;] to go forwards, go on, advance: [[matthew 4 21|Mat.4:21]], [[mark 1 19|Mrk.1:19]]. Metaphorical, of age ([[genesis 18 11|Gen.18:11]], al., Lys., Diod., al.), ἐν τ. ἡμέραις, [[luke 1 7|Luk.1:7, 18 2:36]].† (AS)

προ-βάλλω [in LXX for חוּד, מָרַק, etc. ;] 1. to throw before. 2. to put forward: with accusative, [[acts 19 33|Act.19:33;]] of trees, to put forth, produce (sc. φύλλα), [[luke 21 30|Luk.21:30.]]† (AS)
προβατικός, -ή, -όν (πρόβατον) [in LXX (π. πύλη): [[nehemiah 3 1|Neh.3:1, 32 12:39]] (צֹאן)* ;] of sheep: ἡ π. (sc. πύλη, see supr.), the sheep-gate, [[john 5 2|Jhn.5:2.]]† (AS)

πρόβατον, -ου, τό (προβαίνω), [in LXX chiefly for צֹאן, also for שֶׂה, more rarely for כֶּבֶשׂ (כֶּשֶׂב), רָחֵל ;] 1. in Hom., Hdt., cattle, esp. of small cattle, sheep and goats. 2. In NT, as in Attic writers generally (cf. MM, xxi), a sheep: [[matthew 7 15|Mat.7:15]], [[mark 6 34|Mrk.6:34]], al.; πρόβατα σφαγῆς, [[romans 8 36|Rom.8:36]] (LXX). Metaphorical (in cl. of timidity, stupidity or idleness), of the followers of a leader or master, esp. of those who are subject to the care of the Good Shepherd: [[matthew 10 6|Mat.10:6 15:24 26:31]]" (LXX) [[mark 14 27|Mrk.14:27]] (LXX), [[john 10 7|Jhn.10:7-8, 15-16 10:26-27 21:16-17]] (WH txt., προβάτια), [[hebrews 13 20|Heb.13:20;]] opposite to ἐρίφια, [[matthew 25 33|Mat.25:33.]] προβάτιον, -ου, τό, dimin. of πρόβατον (used as a term of endearment, see El., § 27, 4), a little sheep: [[john 21 16|Jhn.21:16-17]] (πρόβατα, WH, mg.).† (AS)

προ-βιβάζω causal of προβαίνω, [in LXX: [[exodus 35 34|Exo.35:34]] (יָרָה hi.), [[deuteronomy 6 7|Deu.6:7]] (שָׁנַן pi.) * ;] to lead forward, lead on; metaphorically, to induce, incite, urge: [[matthew 14 8|Mat.14:8.]]† (AS)
προ-βλέπω [in LXX: [[psalms 37 13|Psa.37:13]] (רָאָה)* ;] to foresee: mid., [[hebrews 11 40|Heb.11:40]] (see Bl., § 24, 55, 1).† (AS)
προ-γίνομαι [in LXX: Wis.19:13 אA, 2Ma.14:3 2Mac 15:8 * ;] to happen before: pf. pass. ptcp., [[romans 3 25|Rom.3:25.]]† (AS)

προ-γινώσκω [in LXX: Wis.6:13 8:8 18:6 * ;] to know beforehand, foreknow: [[2-peter 3 17|2Pe.3:17;]] with accusative of person(s), [[acts 26 5|Act.26:5;]] of the Divine foreknowledge, [[romans 8 29|Rom.8:29 11:2]], [[1-peter 1 20|1Pe.1:20]].† (AS)
πρό-γνωσις, -εως, ἡ (προγινώσκω) [in LXX: Jdth.9:6 11:19 * ;] fore­knowledge: [[acts 2 23|Act.2:23]], [[1-peter 1 2|1Pe.1:2]].† (AS)

πρό-γονος, -ον (προγίνομαι), [in LXX: [[esther 4 17|Est.4:17]], Sir.8:4, al. ;] 1. born before. 2. As subst., in pl., οἱ π., ancestors, forefathers: [[2-timothy 1 3|2Ti.1:3;]] of living parents (so Plat.), [[1-timothy 5 4|1Ti.5:4.]]† (AS)

προ-γράφω [in LXX: Dan LXX 3:3 cod., 1Ma.10:36 * ;] 1. to write before: [[romans 15 4|Rom.15:4]], [[ephesians 3 3|Eph.3:3]], Ju 4. 2. to write in public, placard, proclaim (Dem., Plut., al.): [[galatians 3 1|Gal.3:1]] (Lft., in l). 3. = ζωγραφέω, to pourtray, depict: Ga, l.with (Syr. Pesh., Chrys.; Field, Notes, 189; CGT, in l).† (AS)
πρό-δηλος, -ον [in LXX: Jdth.8:29, 2Ma.3:17 2Mac 14:39 * ;] 1. evident beforehand. 2. clearly evident: [[1-timothy 5 24|1Ti.5:24-25]] [[hebrews 7 14|Heb.7:14]].† (AS)

προ-δίδωμι [in LXX: [[ezekiel 16 34|Eze.16:34]] A (נָתַן), 4Ma.4:1, al. ;] 1. to give before, give first: [[romans 11 35|Rom.11:35]] ([[job 41 2|Job.41:2]] (11) LXX, al.). 2. to betray (4Mac, l.with).† (AS)
προ-δότης, -ου, ὁ (προδίδωμι) [in LXX: 2Ma.5:15 2Mac 10:13 2Mac 10:22, 3Ma.3:24 * ;] a betrayer, traitor: [[luke 6 16|Luk.6:16]], [[acts 7 52|Act.7:52]], [[2-timothy 3 4|2Ti.3:4]].† (AS)

πρό-δρομος, -ον (προτρέχω) [in LXX: [[numbers 13 21|Num.13:21]] (20), [[isaiah 28 4|Isa.28:4]] (בִּכּוּר), Wis.12:8 * ;] running forward, going in advance. As subst., ὁ π., an advance guard, forerunner: [[hebrews 6 20|Heb.6:20.]]† (AS)

προ-εῖδον aor. without Pres. in use (see: προοράω), [in LXX: [[genesis 37 18|Gen.37:18]] (רָאָה), [[psalms 139 3|Psa.139:3]] (סָכַן hi.) * ;] to foresee: [[acts 2 31|Act.2:31]] (προϊδών; WH, προιδών), [[galatians 3 8|Gal.3:8.]]† (AS)
προ-ελπίζω to hope before: before ἐν, [[ephesians 1 12|Eph.1:12.]]† (AS)

προ-εῖπον 2 aor. from unused Pres. (see: εἶπον, and pf., -είρηκα (3Ma.6:35 *), pass., -είρημαι (2Ma.2:32, 3Ma.1:26, al.), 1. to say before: [[galatians 1 9|Gal.1:9]], [[1-thessalonians 4 6|1Th.4:6]] (on the form -αμεν, see WH, App., 164), [[hebrews 4 7|Heb.4:7;]] before ὅτι, [[2-corinthians 7 3|2Co.7:3 13:2]], [[galatians 5 21|Gal.5:21]]; of prophecy, [[matthew 24 25|Mat.24:25]], [[mark 13 23|Mrk.13:23]], [[acts 1 16|Act.1:16]], [[romans 9 29|Rom.9:29]], [[2-peter 3 2|2Pe.3:2]], Ju 17. 2. to proclaim publicly, declare openly or plainly (cl.): so R, mg., in [[2-corinthians 13 2|2Co.13:2]], [[galatians 5 21|Gal.5:21]], [[1-thessalonians 4 6|1Th.4:6]] (cf. προλέγω; but see supr., and cf. M, Th., 38).† (AS)
προ-ενάρχομαι to begin before: [[2-corinthians 8 6|2Co.8:6;]] with accusative, τὸ θέλειν, [[2-corinthians 8 10|2Co.8:10]] (not elsewhere).† (AS)
προ-επ-αγγέλλω to announce before. Mid., to promise before: with accusative of thing(s), [[romans 1 2|Rom.1:2]], [[2-corinthians 9 5|2Co.9:5]] (Dio. Cass.).† (AS)

προ-ερέω, -ῶ, see: προεῖπον. προ-εῖπον 2 aor. from unused Pres. (see: εἶπον, and pf., -είρηκα (3Ma.6:35 *), pass., -είρημαι (2Ma.2:32, 3Ma.1:26, al.), 1. to say before: [[galatians 1 9|Gal.1:9]], [[1-thessalonians 4 6|1Th.4:6]] (on the form -αμεν, see WH, App., 164), [[hebrews 4 7|Heb.4:7;]] before ὅτι, [[2-corinthians 7 3|2Co.7:3 13:2]], [[galatians 5 21|Gal.5:21]]; of prophecy, [[matthew 24 25|Mat.24:25]], [[mark 13 23|Mrk.13:23]], [[acts 1 16|Act.1:16]], [[romans 9 29|Rom.9:29]], [[2-peter 3 2|2Pe.3:2]], Ju 17. 2. to proclaim publicly, declare openly or plainly (cl.): so R, mg., in [[2-corinthians 13 2|2Co.13:2]], [[galatians 5 21|Gal.5:21]], [[1-thessalonians 4 6|1Th.4:6]] (cf. προλέγω; but see supr., and cf. M, Th., 38).† (AS)

προ-έρχομαι [in LXX: [[genesis 33 3|Gen.33:3, 14]] R (עָבַר), Jdth.2:19, Sir.35:10 (Sir.32:10) al ;] 1. to go forward, go on, advance: before μικρόν, [[matthew 26 39|Mat.26:39]] and [[mark 14 35|Mrk.14:35]] (WH, mg., προσελθών): ῥύμην μίαν (cf. Plat., Rep., i, 328e), [[acts 12 10|Act.12:10.]] 2. Of relative position, to go before, precede: with genitive (cl.; Jth, l.with); with accusative of person(s) (not cl.), [[luke 22 47|Luk.22:47]] (with genitive, Rec.); before ἐνώπιον, [[luke 1 17|Luk.1:17]] (cf. [[genesis 33 3|Gen.33:3]]). 3. Of time, to go before or in advance: [[acts 20 5|Act.20:5, 13]] (WH, mg., R, mg.), [[2-corinthians 9 5|2Co.9:5;]] with accusative of person(s) (= cl. φθάνω), [[mark 6 33|Mrk.6:33.]]† (AS)
προ-ετοιμάζω [in LXX: [[isaiah 28 24|Isa.28:24]] B, Wis.9:8 * ;] to prepare before: with accusative of thing(s), [[romans 9 23|Rom.9:23]] (οἱς for ἅ by attraction), [[ephesians 2 10|Eph.2:10.]]† (AS)
προ-ευαγγελίζομαι to announce glad tidings beforehand: [[galatians 3 8|Gal.3:8.]]† (AS)

προ-έχω [in LXX: [[job 27 6|Job.27:6]] A (חָזַק hi.) * ;] 1. Trans., to hold before; mid., to hold something before oneself (Hdt.), hence, metaphorically, to excuse oneself: [[romans 3 9|Rom.3:9]], R, mg. (but see Field, Notes, 152 f.; Lft., Notes, 266 f.; ICC and Vau., in l). 2. Intrans. (a) to project; (b) in running, to have the start, hence, metaphorically, to excel: pass., Ro, l.with, R, txt. (see reff. supr.).† (AS)

προ-ηγέσμαι [in LXX: [[deuteronomy 20 9|Deu.20:9]] (בְּרוֹשׁ), [[proverbs 17 14|Pro.17:14]] (פָּנִים), 2Ma.4:40, al. ;] 1. to go before as leader (in cl., with genitive, dative): [[romans 12 10|Rom.12:10]] (Chrys., Vg., al.; see ICC, in l). 2. In a sense not elsewhere found, ἀλλήλους προηγούμενοι = ἀ. ἡγούμενοι ὑπερέχοντας: Ro, l.with (ICC, cf. [[1-thessalonians 5 13|1Th.5:13]], [[philippians 2 3|Php.2:3]] and EV "preferring").† (AS)

πρό-θεσις, -εως, ἡ [in LXX: [[exodus 40 4|Exo.40:4, 23]] (עֵרֶךְ), [[1-chronicles 9 32|1Ch.9:32]], al. (מַעֲרֶכֶת), [[2-chronicles 4 19|2Ch.4:19]] (פָּנִים), 1Ma.1:22, 2Ma.3:8, al. ;] 1. a setting forth (Plat., Plut., al.): οἱ ἄρτοι τῆς π. (cf. LXX, ll. with, elsewhere ἄρτοι ἐνώπιοι, [[exodus 25 29|Exo.25:29;]] οἱ ἄ. τοῦ προσώπου, [[nehemiah 10 33|Neh.10:33]]), [[matthew 12 4|Mat.12:4]], [[mark 2 26|Mrk.2:26]], [[luke 6 4|Luk.6:4]]; ἡ π. τῶν ἄρτων, [[hebrews 9 2|Heb.9:2.]] 2. a purpose (Mist., Polyb., al.; 2Mac, l.with): [[acts 11 23|Act.11:23 27:13]], [[romans 8 28|Rom.8:28 9:11]], [[ephesians 1 11|Eph.1:11 3:11]], [[2-timothy 1 9|2Ti.1:9 3:10]].† (AS)

προ-θέσμιος, -α, -ον [in Sm.: [[job 28 3|Job.28:3]], [[daniel 9 26|Dan.9:26]] * ;] appointed before­hand. In Attic law, as subst. (so always in cl.), ἡ π. (sc. ἡμέρα), a day appointed beforehand, a previously appointed time: [[galatians 4 2|Gal.4:2.]]† (AS)
προθυμία, -ας, ἡ (πρόθυμος), [in LXX: Sir.45:23 * ;] eagerness, willingness, readiness: [[acts 17 11|Act.17:11]], [[2-corinthians 8 11|2Co.8:11-12 8:19 9:2]].† (AS)

πρόθυμος, -ον [in LXX: [[1-chronicles 28 21|1Ch.28:21]], [[2-chronicles 29 31|2Ch.29:31]] (נָדִיב), [[habakkuk 1 8|Hab.1:8]] (חוּשׁ), al. ;] willing, ready: [[matthew 26 41|Mat.26:41]], [[mark 14 38|Mrk.14:38]]; neut., τὸ π. = ἡ προθυμία (Thuc., al., 3Ma.5:26), οὕτως τὸ κατ᾽ ἐμὲ (= cl. τὸ ἐμὸν) π., [[romans 1 15|Rom.1:15]] (but see ICC, in l).† (AS)
προθύμως [in LXX: [[2-chronicles 29 34|2Ch.29:34]] (יָשָׁר לֵבָב), Tob.7:8, al. ;] eagerly, readily, with a ready mind: [[1-peter 5 2|1Pe.5:2.]]† (AS)

προ-ΐστημι [in LXX: [[2-kings 13 17|2Ki.13:17]], [[proverbs 23 5|Pro.23:5 26:17]], [[isaiah 43 24|Isa.43:24]], [[amos 6 10|Amo.6:10]] (no proper Heb. equiv.), Dan LXX Bel 1:7, 1Ma.5:19, 4Ma.11:27 * ;] 1. trans. in fut., 1 aor., and mid. 1 aor., to put before, set over (Plat., al.). 2. Intrans., in pf., plpf., 2 aor. and mid. Pres. and impf.; (a) to preside, rule, govern: [[romans 12 8|Rom.12:8]], [[1-timothy 5 17|1Ti.5:17]]; with genitive, [[1-thessalonians 5 12|1Th.5:12]], [[1-timothy 3 4|1Ti.3:4-5 3:12]]; (b) to direct, maintain: with genitive of thing(s), καλῶν ἔργων, [[titus 3 8|Tit.3:8, 14]] (on R, mg., profess honest occupations, see CGT, in l; Field, Notes, 223 f.).† (AS)
προ-καλέω, -ῶ [in LXX: 2Ma.8:11 A * ;] to call forth. Most frequently in mid., (a) to challenge; hence, to provoke: [[galatians 5 26|Gal.5:26;]] (b) to invite (2Mac, l.with).† (AS)
προ-κατ-αγγέλλω to announce beforehand: with accusative and inf., [[acts 3 18|Act.3:18;]] before περί, [[acts 7 52|Act.7:52.]]† (AS)
προ-κατ-αρτίζω to make ready beforehand: [[2-corinthians 9 5|2Co.9:5.]]† (AS)

πρό-κειμαι [in LXX: [[exodus 39 18|Exo.39:18]] (36), [[numbers 4 7|Num.4:7]] (פָּנִים), etc. ;] used as pass. of προτίθημι; 1. to be set before one, to be set forth: [[hebrews 6 18|Heb.6:18 12:1-2]], Ju 7. 2. to present oneself, be present: [[2-corinthians 8 12|2Co.8:12]] (see Mey., in l).† (AS)
προ-κηρύσσω 1. to proclaim by herald. 2. Of one who acts as a herald, to proclaim: [[acts 13 24|Act.13:24.]]† (AS)

προ-κοπή, -ῆς, ἡ (προκόπτω), [in LXX: Sir.51:17, 2Ma.8:8 * ;] progress (prop., on a journey, then generally): [[philippians 1 12|Php.1:12, 25]], [[1-timothy 4 15|1Ti.4:15]] (condemned by Atticists, see Rutherford, NPhr., 158).† (AS)

προ-κόπτω [in Sm.: [[psalms 45 5|Psa.45:5]] * ;] to cut forward a way, for­ward, advance, in cl. trans. with neut. adj., as οὐδὲν π., τὰ πολλὰ π. In late writers (Polyb., al.), wholly intrans., to advance, progress: of time, [[romans 13 12|Rom.13:12.]] Metaphorical, [[luke 2 52|Luk.2:52]], [[galatians 1 14|Gal.1:14]], [[2-timothy 2 16|2Ti.2:16 3:9 3:13]].† (AS)
πρό-κριμα, -τος, τό (cl. προκρίνειν, 1. to prefer. 2. to judge beforehand), pre-judging, prejudice: [[1-timothy 5 21|1Ti.5:21]] (see Cremer, 378).† (AS)
